transcript.content: Hello. What brings you into the clinic today?

Hi. Well, I came in because I just feel like I cannot get my schoolwork and my little accessories shop organized at the same time. It's... it's getting really overwhelming. My shop supplies, school due dates, receipts, assignment notes—they all just end up in these huge piles everywhere. I look at it all and I honestly just don't know what to do first.
Did you have similar difficulties with organization and keeping track of your schoolwork when you were growing up?

Yeah, I did. Actually, my mom still has some of my old notes from elementary school teachers. They were always saying how I was constantly out of my seat, or... you know, just talking before being called on. And they said I was always rushing through our group activities, even when I actually understood the work fine. So, yeah, school has always been kind of chaotic for me.
Nowadays, do you often feel physically restless or have trouble sitting still for long periods?

Yeah, definitely. Um, even when I'm not actually going anywhere, I just feel like my body is buzzing. Like I really need to be moving around. It's especially hard when I'm supposed to just sit still and listen to someone. I just always feel that need to move.
Do you often find yourself interrupting people or finishing their sentences before they can finish speaking?

Yeah, I definitely do that. Um, like in group critiques or class discussions, I tend to just jump in with my answer before the other person is even done talking. And then I usually feel really embarrassed right after, because I realize I just guessed what they were going to say and completely cut them off.
